assignments.reason: This node means 'bind His divinity in your thought.' Its essential nature is the active practice of connecting to the divine sekhel/mah — the core substance of Package 1 (Adam and Divine Order). The Torah explicitly equates this with 'machshavah — cheshov mah' and with drawing down YHVH be-milui alfin. It is the human act of attaching to the Adam/divine-order principle through consciousness.

assignments.node_id: יתבטלו כל המלחמות וכל הרצונות נגד רצונך
assignments.reason: This node means 'all wars and all opposing wills against your will shall be nullified.' Its essential nature is the restoration of divine order (ke-seder) — things going according to your will because you are aligned with the divine mah. The Torah frames this as the result of drawing down Adam/mah: 've-al yedei zeh yitbatlu kol ha-milchamot.' The nullification of disorder is itself the state of order/shleimut, which is the core identity of Package 1.
